title: S2-B2 supplemental scientific clarification freeze
decision: Freeze the prospective supplemental clarification for SW10_S2_B2_PROTOCOL_V1 before any B2 outcomes are computed. Recover direction only where pre-B1 semantics support it; otherwise designate NON_DIRECTIONAL. Define the primary BH family, legacy-volume diagnostic role, standardized-effect calculation/threshold, and deterministic disposition mapping.
rationale: The original B2 freeze omitted complete factor-direction, BH-family membership, and gate-to-disposition rules. Work stopped before scientific execution. This supplement resolves those omissions prospectively without editing the original frozen decision or using B1 outcome direction to manufacture hypotheses.
evidence: Pre-B1 research_factors semantics support continuation for RET_MOM and reversal for SHORT_REV. VOL_TURN requires interaction, VOL_REGIME is context/risk, GAP_OVN includes acceptance/reversal, and HIGH52 includes extrema proximity/breakout state, so those four do not support a unique HIGH-minus-LOW directional hypothesis. PR55 prepared factor formulas were inspected only to align semantic direction with factor sign, not to inspect outcomes. No B2 scientific job/artifact exists.

metadata_json.legacy_rule: VOL_TURN_B1_LEGACY remains diagnostic-only, excluded from primary BH family and cannot receive ADVANCE disposition.

horizon_support.neighbor_coherence: at least one immediately adjacent prespecified horizon has same spread sign as supported horizon; for directional factors that sign must equal hypothesized sign

stability_gates.symbol: leave-top-5-out does not reverse required sign
stability_gates.temporal: at least 3 of 4 blocks match required sign; no block >50% absolute aggregate effect

HIGH52.basis: pre-B1 proximity/breakout semantics do not uniquely specify continuation vs reversal

SHORT_REV.basis: pre-B1 reversal semantics; factor value is prior-day return

VOL_TURN_V2_CAUSAL.basis: pre-B1 interaction-required semantics do not specify standalone sign

disposition_mapping.RETAIN_AS_WEAK_EVIDENCE: semantic/testable factor not ADVANCE; directional: at least one horizon has hypothesized-direction mean spread and either FDR support or abs(standardized_effect)>=0.20 but fails one or more advance robustness gates. non-directional: at least one horizon passes FDR + neighbor same-sign coherence + abs(standardized_effect)>=0.20 + temporal + symbol gates; observed sign is descriptive only and may seed a separately preregistered future hypothesis
disposition_mapping.ADVANCE_TO_S2_ROBUSTNESS: directional factor only; at least one horizon passes hypothesized direction + FDR + neighbor coherence + abs(standardized_effect)>=0.20, and corresponding temporal and symbol-concentration gates pass; no unresolved semantic defect
disposition_mapping.RETAIN_AS_COUNTEREVIDENCE: all remaining semantic/testable cases, including directional factors with no horizon meeting weak-evidence condition and non-directional factors lacking the full weak-evidence structure

metadata_json.non_directional_rule: NON_DIRECTIONAL factors cannot receive ADVANCE_TO_S2_ROBUSTNESS in B2; B2 may only yield WEAK_EVIDENCE or COUNTEREVIDENCE for them. Any direction learned from B2 must be preregistered before an independent later validation test.
